title: Street
description: A person small in a street or another built place. The person stays sharp enough to read. The street is only slightly softened so the place remains.
reason: A person in a street stays recognizable, and the street around them is only slightly softened so the place remains.

features.person: The person stays sharp enough to read.
features.street: The street is only slightly softened, so the place remains.

subject.skip: Skip the person when nobody is clearly separate from the street.

eyes.skip: Skip the eyes when the person is too small for an eye to matter.

skin.skip: Skip skin. Skin smoothing does not belong on this picture.

sky.skip: Skip the sky. The sky is not a separate grade here.

background.skip: Skip the street blur when the person could not be isolated.

foreground.skip: Skip the foreground. The frame is handled by the global grade.
